task.summary: The target video is a slow underwater drift around <Subject 1>, who sings one sustained line into the water. The identical line is sung, not spoken, and the sequence is judged against that sung brief. Two shots: a wide drifting orbit, and a close on her face through rising bubbles as she sings.

geometry_stage_2.resolved_by: the release Qwen still processor at batch build

subjects.definition: the figure defined jointly by the four views in <Picture 1>: pale luminous skin, long silver-white hair falling in wet strands, and a long tail of overlapping iridescent pale-blue scales ending in translucent fanned fins, with matching fin membranes at the forearms. Retain the hair colour, the scale colour and the fin structure; the plain sheet background is not part of her.
subjects.retention: partially_preserved - hair, skin tone, scale colour and fin structure are held exactly; her pose, the water around her and the light follow the shot description rather than the reference sheet

shots.camera: wide slow orbit, the camera drifting left to right as though carried by the current, shafts of pale surface light falling from above
shots.action: <Subject 1> hangs suspended in deep blue-green water, tail curling slowly beneath her, silver hair lifting and spreading around her head.

events.requirement: She does not sing while the orbit holds wide and her lips stay closed.

shots.closing: A slow column of bubbles rises past her from somewhere below the frame.

shots.camera: the orbit tightens to a close single on her face, the surface light rippling across her cheek
shots.action: <Subject 1> tips her head back and opens her mouth to sing, bubbles streaming upward past her jaw.

events.speaker: <Subject 1>
events.words: The tide will carry me home again
events.delivery: sings one sustained legato phrase, clear and unhurried, held across the whole shot
events.mouth: her mouth open and shaping the sung vowels throughout
events.lead: Tipping her head back, <Subject 1> sings one sustained legato phrase, clear and unhurried

shots.closing: The last vowel sustains as the bubbles thin and the light on her face dims toward the end of the phrase.

sound.overall: A dense underwater ambience of low pressure rumble and the fine rush of rising bubbles. A single sustained sung female phrase carries across the second half, close and slightly reverberant as though heard underwater, with no spoken narration anywhere in the sequence.
sound.non_diegetic: A sparse sustained string pad well under the voice, entering with the sung phrase and holding one chord to the end.

render.matched_seeds: the whole seed set is rendered for every arm

_notes: The contrast for this row is the same SUNG brief with the lyrics pair removed, never a spoken-narration brief; the brief is explicit that lyrics must be compared against sung delivery.
